Commentary.Commentary: That is it from this game then! The second ODI now becomes a must-win for the visitors whereas, Australia can clinch the series with a win in Sydney. That game will be played on the 19th of this month and it begins at 0850 IST (0320 GMT). Till then, goodbye and take care!

Pat Cummins says he is happy to get this win. Applauds the performance of Ashton Agar. Says it was a management decision to keep Josh Hazlewood out. Shares it was a good opening partnership. Reckons he is getting better and better as well.

Dawid Malan wins the Player of the Match award. He says it was a good wicket with a lot of bounce. Adds it was though to miss the latter stage of the World Cup but he had to come here and prove his fitness. Shares that Australia bowled well with the new ball. Feels they were 30-40 runs short. Reckons it was important to score runs, hopes to keep scoring and stay in the squad.
...Presentation coming up...

Earlier in the day, after electing to bowl, Australia kept picking wickets at regular intervals but it was Malan's outstanding knock which took England close to 300 which we felt was a competitive score then. However, it was easily knocked off by the Aussies courtesy some excellent batting by Head, Smith and Warner.

The English bowlers will be disappointed with the way they bowled, yes the wicket was flat but they would have loved to make Australia work hard for their runs. There were far too many boundary balls first up and they were quite inconsistent with their lines and lengths. Once the two openers fell though, the likes of Willey, Stone and Dawson bowled quite well but the game was gone by then.

A dominating win then for the Aussies to take a 1-0 lead in this series. Have to say, the victory was set by the openers who were on the charge right from the word go. They added 147 in no time with both scoring half tons. That more or less turned the tide completely into the favor of the Aussies. Then there was another handy stand between Warner and Smith before Warner fell 14 short of a ton. Australia then kept losing wickets at regular intervals but the run chase was always under their control. Once the two openers fell, Smith took the onus onto himself, stayed till the end and took his side over the line.
SIX! Smith hits the winning runs. Tossed up on middle. Smith heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a biggie. AUSTRALIA WIN BY 6 WICKETS.
FOUR! Pitched up on middle. Smith clears his front leg and smashes it to long on for four runs.
Flatter and on middle. Smith skips down and blocks it.
On middle. Smith smacks it to mid on but hits Green on the other end, on his boot and deflects to mid-wicket.
Short and outside off, cut to point.
FOUR! Pulled away! Short in length and on off. Green pulls it to deep mid-wicket for four. 7 runs needed now.
A bouncer on middle. Green leaves it alone.
Length ball, outside off, Green punches it to cover.
On middle, this is hit to mid-wicket for a single.
Short in length and on middle. Green pulls it to deep square leg for one.
Length and on middle, flicked to deep square leg for one.
Flatter and outside off, Green punches it to cover. He wanted a single but was sent back and a misfield allows him to get back.
On middle, blocked out.
Goes very full and on middle. Smith works it to long on for one more.
Tossed up on middle, Smith drives it to mid off.
Fuller ball on off driven to long off for a single.
Full, outside off, slower. Green watchfully lets it go.
Tad short and on middle, this is pulled to deep mid-wicket for one.
Short and outside off. Smith plays it to backward point for a single.
A length ball, outside off. Green pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Wood goes for the bouncer, outside off. Green lets it go.
Length ball, outside off. Green looks to cut but misses.
On middle, blocked out.

FOUR! On middle. Smith heaves it to deep mid-wicket. The fielder there flicks it back but stumbles along the way and the ball touches his hips while he was in contact with the ropes. Given as a boundary in the end.
Slanting on leg, this is pushed to mid on.
Shorter and outside off. Smith cuts it through point for a couple of runs.
Wide! Way outside off, left alone.
Full and way outside off. Green drives it hard. Jason Roy puts a hand on its way and does some damage. Looks in pain. A single.
FOUR! Green was trying for a long time and finally hits one off the middle. Full and outside off. Green skips down and launches it over mid off for a boundary.
This is full and way outside off, it is driven to cover.
Length and on off, pushed to mid off.
Excellent fielding in the deep! Full and outside off. Smith drives it through covers. The fielder runs to his right, dives and saves a couple.
Wide! Too short and on off. Smith leaves it alone. Wided.
Short and on middle. Green pulls it to deep mid-wicket where the player collects on a bounce. One.
Short of a length and on middle. Smith bunts it to mid-wicket for one.
A length ball, outside off. Green pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on middle, pushed to mid off.
Flatter and on middle, Green whips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed to covers.
On middle, blocked out.
This is full and on middle, spins in. Green comes down to track to go big but gets an inside edge and onto the pads. The ball rolls back to the bowler.Green trying to go big here.
This is full and on middle, flicked past mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and outside off, Smith punches to the right of point.
FOUR! That is a solid on-drive! Length and on middle, Green hammers it past mid on, uppishly but there is no one there. Boundary to get off the mark.
A yorker now and on middle, Green jams it out.
A full toss on middle, Green strokes it to mid on.
Angled into the pads, this is worked to mid-wicket.
On off, defended.
Shorter and on middle, Smith pulls it through square leg for one.

OUT! TAKEN! Dawson gets Carey! Carey will feel a touch unlucky there. He really hit that well. On middle, Carey brings out the reverse sweep, he strikes it really well. It goes towards deep point. Salt there takes it nicely above his head. 44 more needed.
Commentary.Howout: c Philip Salt b Liam Dawson

Commentary.Commentary: A single as this is eased down to long off.
On off, this is pushed back to the bowler.
On middle, defended.
Carey gets out the sweep, he hits it through square leg for one.

A loud appeal only from the bowler but turned down! Buttler reviews it! It seems like it has spun way too much and going down leg. NOT OUT! It is clipping the leg pole! It remains umpire's call! England do not lose their review. That though spun a long way. This lands outside off and spins back in sharply. Carey looks to flick by moving across but misses to get hit on the pads.
A yorker on middle, Smith pushes it back towards the bowler.
A short one, left alone.
Misfield! On the pads, this is clipped towards fine leg. The fielder does not stop it cleanly. He recovers well to stop it from going over the fence. Two in the end.
A slower one, on middle, Smith works it to mid on.
Fuller and around off, Smith pushes it to mid off.
Bangs this short and on middle, Smith evades it nicely.
A dot to end! On middle, defended.
Angled into the pads, this is worked down to fine leg for one.
Another one on the fuller side, outside off, Carey strokes it through covers for one more run.
Shorter in length and outside off, Smith pushes it through covers for one.
Angled into the pads, Smith works it to mid-wicket.
Carved away! Shorter and outside off, Smith stands tall and guides it past point. Two taken.
Fuller and on middle, Carey works it to mid on.
Yet another short one, Smith pulls it towards fine leg and gets to the other end.
Bangs it short, Carey pulls it nicely towards fine leg and takes one.
Length and on off, Carey strokes it on the up but to mid off.
Angled into the pads, Carey works it to mid-wicket.
Angled into the pads, Smith works it through square leg and takes one.
FOUR! Uppish but through the gap! Second boundary in the over. Length and outside off, Carey intentionally hits it in the air, over covers, no one in the deep and it results in another boundary.
Good comeback from Willey! A yorker on middle, Carey jams it out towards mid-wicket.

EDGY FOUR! Frustration for Willey who has been good in this spell! Length and outside off, extra bounce on this one, Carey still goes after it, it flies off the outside edge, past the keeper and down to the third man fence.
Length and on off, Carey pushes it to covers.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled towards fine leg for a couple.
Angled into the pads, Carey looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. Half an appeal but turned down.
On off, Smith pushes it back to the bowler.
Another one on a length and around off, this is pushed through covers for one more.
FOUR! Cracked, caressed, wonderful. That is a lovely stroke! Not a very bad delivery, length and on off, Carey strokes it on the up and hits it through covers for a boundary.
Well fielded! Shorter and on off, Carey pushes it off the back foot. The fielder dives to his right and stops it well.
Angled into the off pole, Carey gets right behind the line and defends.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Willey goes full again, gets the ball to shape back in nicely, this is driven back to the bowler.
Another dot! Fuller and on off, Carey plays it to cover.
Bangs it short and on middle, Carey pulls it to mid-wicket.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed to mid off for one more.
Shorter and outside off, Carey slashes at it, it goes off the outside edge down to third man for one.
Fuller again and on middle, Carey strokes it to mid on.
Shorter and on off, Smith defends.
Slightly fuller, Smith hits it on the up but finds cover.
Back of a length and on off, this is pushed to mid off.
Good length and on middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
Shortens his length and bowls it on off, Smith pushes it towards cover and takes one.
FOUR! Glorious! That is as straight as it gets! Fuller and on middle, Smith creams it past the mid off fielder and into the fence. Beautiful.
Some shape back in for Willey! This is fuller, this starts on off and then comes back in. Carey looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Shorter and outside off, Smith guides it past point and gets to the other end.
Fuller and on middle, Carey works it through mid-wicket and takes one.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed to cover.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! That is a superb catch from Buttler! Marnus Labuschagne walks back for a single digit score. A happy phase for England. Still though, they will need a miracle to get back into the game. Willey is delighted and so is Buttler. This is full and outside off, tailing away. Marnus Labuschagne looks to drive but away from the body, this goes off the outside edge. Jos Buttler dives full stretch to his right, sticks a hand out and takes it brilliantly.
Commentary.Howout: c Jos Buttler b David Willey

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller and outside off, Smith opens the face of the bat and guides it past point for a run.
Short and on middle. Smith pulls it in front of square leg for a single.
On middle, Smith blocks it out.
On a length and around off. Smith punches it to cover.
Length ball on top of off. Labuschagne guides it to third man for a single.
On middle. Labuschagne pulls it wide of deep square leg. Good fielding there. Two runs.
Touch fuller and around off. Labuschagne drops it to cover.
A length ball on off. Smith knocks it to cover.
Labuschagne is off the mark as he flicks this length ball to square leg.
Length and on off, tucked to mid-wicket.

OUT! TAKEN! Finally, something to cheer for the Englishmen! Short in length and on middle. Warner pulls it very flat, it goes to deep square leg where Sam Billings runs in and takes it. He does well to hold on. End of an excellent innings from Warner. Australia needed a good start and it was well provided by Warner. An easy job for the upcoming batters now as only 88 runs are needed.
Commentary.Howout: c Sam Billings b David Willey

Commentary.Commentary: A length ball, outside off. Smith punches it through covers for a single. 200 up for the Aussies.
Length ball, outside off. Warner clips it to deep square leg for a single.
Length and on middle. Blocked out.
Length and on top of middle. Warner bunts it to square leg for a single.
This is full and on middle. Warner makes a solid defense.
Short of a length and outside off. Warner looks to cut but misses.
Fuller ball on middle. Smith clips it past square leg for a single.
On middle, defended out.
Outside off again, this is hit straight to backward point.
Outside off, Warner dabs it through backward point for a couple.
On off, pushed to mid off.
Flatter and on middle. Smith punches it through covers for a single.
On middle, this is hit to mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Dealing in boundaries, these two now! Tossed up on middle. Warner sweeps it to square leg for a boundary.
FOUR! This is proper placement! Short in length and outside off. Smith stays back, opens the face of the bat and guides it past backward point for four.100 more runs needed now.
FOUR! Well timed! Full and on the pads. Smith flicks it through square leg and the ball finds the fence.
Length and on off. Kept out.
FOUR! Through the gap! Superb! Pitched up, outside off. Smith leans and drives it through covers, no chance for mid off as well.
A length ball, on top of off. Smith taps it to cover.
Full and around off. Defended out.
Tossed up on middle. Smith punches it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, swept behind square leg for one.
Tossed up, outside off, pushed to point.
Flatter and on middle. Smith punches it to long on for a single.
Tossed up on middle. Warner sweeps it to deep square leg for one.
On middle, kept out.
FOUR! poor follow up from Stone! Comes with a fuller delivery and on off. Smith drives it through covers and it races into the fence in no time.
FOUR! A couple of good shots from Smith! Short and outside off. Smith gets on top of the ball as he pulls it past mid-wicket for a boundary.
Length and outside off. Smith knocks it to cover. A misfield but no run is taken.
Short in length and on middle, pulled to deep square leg for a single.
Outside off, dabbed softly to third man for a single.
This is full and outside off. Smith drives it to cover.
Flatter and outside off. Blocked out. 7 off the over.
This is full and outside off. Warner drives hard to cover.
Around off, pushed back to the bowler.
This is full and on middle, slower again. Warner tries to sweep but miscues, it goes off the top edge to fine leg for a couple.
Slower, full and on middle, drilled to long on for one.
FOUR! Bang! Tossed up, outside off. Smith uses his feet and goes over mid-wicket to find himself a boundary.
Short in length and on middle. Smith pulls it to deep square leg for one.
Short again, angling on leg. Smith sits under it.
Short and outside off. Smith punches straight to cover.
Around off. Smith defends again.
On middle, defended out.
A length ball, outside off. Smith punches off the back foot through point for a brace.
This is full and on off. Smith eases it to long off for one.
A single as this is worked to long on.
Flatter and outside off, Smith drives it through covers for one.
Tossed up, outside off. Warner paddles it to deep square leg for one.
This is full and outside off. Warner skips down to drive but splices it to point.
Tossed up, outside off. Warner dabs it to point.
Outside off, left alone. End of a successful over for Jordan.
WIDE! This one is bowled down the leg side. Wided.
BEATEN! That is a beauty! This is angled into the off pole, it lands and then moves away. Smith is beaten as he tries to defend.

OUT! TAKEN! Stop the press, England finally manage to get a wicket! England though need at least two or three more quickly. End of an entertaining knock from Head. Perishes in the attempt to find the fence. This is short and on middle, Head hammers the pull. It goes straight to deep mid-wicket where it is taken by Salt.
Commentary.Howout: c Philip Salt b Chris Jordan

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter and outside off, Warner looks to cut but it goes off the inside edge towards fine leg for one.
WIDE! Very short and outside off, left alone. Wided.
On off, Head drops it towards cover for one.
FOUR! What a shot that is! Head is seeing the ball really well now. A slower one on middle and it is picked very early. This is lofted well over the bowler's head and into the fence.
BEATEN! Fires this one outside off, Warner looks to defend but he does so for the turn. It goes on with the arm and past the outside edge.
Just short! Shorter and outside off, Head looks to cut, it goes uppishly towards point. Curran, the sub, dives to his right and makes a half stop. Only one.

FOUR! That has been smacked and to hit that towards mid-wicket, is really good. He used the whole of his reach! This is slower and outside off, Head goes down on one knee, waits for a second and then slams it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Looks to cut again but is beaten again! The length is not read right here. This is quite full and outside off, Head looks to cut but misses.
Two more! Fuller and on middle, Head pushes it down towards long on for two.
That is pushed through! It is outside off, Head looks to cut but is beaten.
A slower one now, outside off, Head pushes it through covers and takes one.
Shorter and on the pads, Warner pulls it towards fine leg for one.
Fuller and outside off, this is pushed through covers for two.
Shorter and outside off, Warner chops it to cover.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
Good length and on off, defended.

FOUR! Over mid off again! Picks his spot really well. Makes excellent use of the feet, gets to the pitch of the ball, does not look to hit it too hard, just lofts it over mid off for another boundary. Just the 159 more needed.
Quicker and on off, Head pushes it to covers.
Angled into the pads, Warner works it through square leg for one.
All the shots are coming in now! Warner plays the paddle scoop, he drags it from outside off and plays it towards fine leg for two.
Well bowled! He sees Warner come down the track and fires it outside off, Warner adjusts and plays it to point.
FOUR! Raining boundaries here! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled towards deep mid-wicket, it is away from the fielder and it is another boundary.

FOUR! He gets to his fifty in style! Australia are racing away with the game. Head grabbing the opportunity provided to him. He though would love to make a big one here. This is full and on the pads, it is whipped over mid-wicket and it goes for a one-bounce boundary.
FOUR! Down the ground and now Head is nearing his half ton! Length and on off, Head slams it down the ground and it goes down to the long off fence.
That is a superb shot! Shorter and on off, Warner stands tall and pushes it past cover. The fielder in the deep, runs to his left and keeps it down to three.
A slower one from Jordan. Fuller and on off, Warner pushes it to mid off.

FOUR! Olly Stone lets that through! The dive was not right! Short and on middle, this is pulled to the left of mid on. Stone runs there but his dive is well away from the ball, he then looks to reach out for it but the ball goes past him and into the fence.
Warner misses out! This is short and outside off, he cuts but finds point.
Very full and on off, Warner sweeps it through mid-wicket for another run.
Good sensible batting! Follows the boundary with one as he pushes it down to long on for one.

FOUR! Up and over! 100 up for the Aussies. That is a really clever shot. Steps out, makes it into a half volley and just lofts it over mid off for a boundary. The fielder was in the ring so he just needed to get it over him.
Tossed up on off, Warner plays it through square leg and takes one.
Shorter and outside off, Head slaps it through covers for one.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to mid off.
Slower one, outside off, Head slaps it through covers and takes one. A tidy over from Jordan.
Angled into the pads, Head looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.

Fifty for Warner! A quality, quality knock from him! He was not in the best of forms in the World Cup but has played brilliantly here! He gets there by jamming this full delivery outside off towards cover for one.
Fuller and on middle, Warner strokes it to mid off.
On the pads, this is worked towards square leg for one more.
Shorter and well wide outside off, Head slashes at it but misses. Not a lot of foot movement from Head there.
Angled into the pads, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Yet another one which takes off after landing. On a length and around off, Warner looks to defend but the ball hits his splice as there is extra bounce.
Another one on the shorter side, Head pulls, it goes towards fine leg for one more.
That has been cracked away! Shorter and on middle, Warner pulls it through square leg for one.
FOUR! That has raced away! Slightly shorter and on off, Warner gets into position early and punches it past cover for a boundary.
Angled into the pads, Warner works it towards mid-wicket.
Angled into the pads, Warner works it through square leg for one.
Shorter again and on off, Head pushes it through covers and gets to the other end.
Back of a length and on off, Head pushes it towards cover.
Shortish again but closer to the body, this is pushed through covers for one.
FOUR! Warner moves into the 40s! Shorter and outside off, he cuts it past point and this one races away to the fence.
Angled into the pads, Head works it around the corner and takes one.
Two good deliveries to end but the damage was done earlier on! On a length and around off, kept out.
Corrects his line and bowls it on a length and around off, defended.
FOUR LEG BYES! Three in a row for the Aussies! They are running away with the game now! On the pads, Warner looks to work it fine but misses, it hits the pad and races down to the fine leg fence.
FOUR! This is right in the gap! Firmly hit and perfectly off the middle. Shorter and on the pads, Warner pulls it hard and this races away to the backward square leg fence.
TOP EDGE AND FOUR! Everything going the Aussies' way! Short and on the body, Warner looks to pull, this flies off the top edge, over the keeper and towards the fine leg fence.
Angled into the pads, Head works it through square leg for one.
End of Powerplay 1! Now, 4 fielders are allowed outside the 30-yard circle.
A single to end the over! Short in length and on the hips. Head whacks it behind square leg for one.
Full and on middle. Head whips it to square leg.
FOUR! Head is looking to be the aggressor now! A couple of good shots from him! Bit of width, outside off and Head slashes it over covers for four.
A proper bouncer now on middle. Head looks to pull but misses.
FOUR! Well played! Touch short and on middle. Head pulls it past square leg for another boundary for him.
A single as this is hit to cover.
On the pads, clipped to square leg for one.
This is full and on off, pushed to mid off.
Short and on middle. Head pulls, not off the middle and will only get one.
Outside off, punched to covers.
A length ball, outside off. Head looks to go downtown as he swings but misses.
A length ball on middle. Head flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a couple. Good running.
Luke Wood to bowl now.
Length ball, outside off. Warner pulls in the gap, to mid-wicket for easy two. 50 up! Australia starting strongly.
On middle, pulled to square leg for one.

That was an effort ball! A length ball on off, this one shoots dearly off the deck. Warner prods to defend but goes off the shoulder of the bat and lobs to the backward point region. Lands safely for one.
A length ball, outside off. Warner punches it to cover where the fielder gets a hand on it and stops running away to the fence. Just two.
Short in length and on middle. Head fends it to square leg for a single.
A length ball on middle. Defended out.
Goes full, outside off. Warner drives straight to mid off.
A length ball, outside off. Warner looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Length and on off, nipping away. Warner nudges it to mid-wicket.
Wide! A bouncer again but this is going down. Wided.
Serves a bouncer on middle. Warner sits under it.
On middle, clipped to deep square leg for a couple.
SIX! As easy as you like! On a length and on middle. Warner steps across and laps it over fine leg for a biggie. Made it look so easy.
A length ball on middle. Head drops it to cover. A good over by Stone, he looks in good shape.
On top of off, Head taps it to point.
Length and on off, Head plays it to cover.
Swing and a miss! Short of a length and on middle. Head swings across but only gets an inside edge and gets hit on the thigh.
FOUR! Crunched! A length ball, outside off. Head powers it through covers, in the gap for four.
Length ball, outside off, knocked to cover.
FOUR! Starts and ends the over with a boundary! This is full and on middle. Warner swings and clears mid on, the ball makes its way into the fence. Good start by Australia, a positive start.
Around off, nudged to mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on middle, flicked to mid-wicket for one.
Outside off, left alone.
On a length and around off. Warner tries to play with soft hands but does so inside the line.
FOUR! That was some shot! This one swings away but it is pitched up. Warner leans and uppishly drives over covers for a boundary.
Length and outside off, pushed to mid off.
SIX! First off the chase! Short in length and on middle. Head is quick on the back foot, he pulls it to the shorter side to square leg for a biggie.
Full and on middle, shapes back in. Head pushes it to mid on.
Touch short and around off at 144 clicks. Head looks to punch but it was too close for him to play that shot.
A length ball on middle. Head tucks it to mid-wicket.
Outside off. Head looks to cut but misses.
Outside off, left alone.
On a length and outside off, bit of extra bounce. Head looks to cut but gets an outside edge to third man for a single.
On middle. Warner tickles it to short fine leg. A quick single is taken.
FOUR! Good shot!! On a length and outside off. Warner leans and drives it through covers for a boundary.

This is around off. Warner knocks it to point. The fielder there misfields and Warner tries to sneak a single. The player from cover is quick to the ball and Warner had to put in a dive to get back in the crease.
This is full and around off. Head eases it to point for a single.
Full and outside off, it is pushed to mid off.
Olly goes full now, outside off. Warner pushes it to point.
Serves it outside off again. Warner is happy to let go.
This is full and outside off. Left alone.
This is again outside off. Warner is hard on his cut shot, underedges it to the first slip fielder.
A length ball, outside off. Warner shoulders arms to it.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is Olly Stone.
Full and outside off, driven to mid off.
FOUR! Edged away! This is full and on off, it lands and swings away. Head looks to drive to mid on but gets an outside edge, past slips and to the third man fence.
This one swings away, full and outside off. Warner looks to drive but outside edges it to deep point for one.
A length ball, outside off, bit of in swing. Head looks to punch but gets an inside edge to square leg. Off the mark with a single.
Wide! This one is sliding down the leg side. Head misses his flick.
On a length and around off. Head hops and blocks it out.
Leg bye! Starts with a length ball, slanting on the pads. Warner looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. A leg bye as it rolls to square leg. Australia are underway.
